palette: imperial yellow notice boards + cream paper cards + vermilion bureau seals + moss approvals + indigo gate frames + gold stamps + ink strips
typography: notice bureau headlines, cream card labels, square vermilion verdict stamps, dashed posting rules
composition: a public-notice freeze gate holding the bill valid but paused, a void-verdict desk turning the bill into waste paper with all parties freed of bill liability, and a scrap-payment desk charging the forger with a civil payment duty
surface: yellow bureau walls with cream notices and vermilion frames; no glossy panels
motion: notices are posted at the gate, the verdict gavel voids the bill, the forger pays through the civil desk; no idle loops
transition: the yellow notice bureau persists while each scene re-stages the same posting board for a new question
